title: The Rebound Discipline
summary: The school discipline of a field that returns every wrong to its doer; the last lesson is the school's great return over the whole company of foes.

title: The Debt Core Canon
summary: The school canon of the formed Core as a ledger that keeps every debt and closes them all in one great stroke.

title: The Even Hand Discipline
summary: The school discipline of the open hand that gives back exactly what was given; it ends in the school's even judgment.

title: The Wheel Core Canon
summary: The school canon of the Core as a turning wheel that lifts the doers of good and grinds the doers of harm.
